scalars.scalar_value: EXPERIENCE: Two years of clerical experience.

items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet the qualifications for the Clerk III position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: Experience Requirement - One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement - One year of education is equal to 30 semester units (45 quarter units). Education must be from an accredited institution. Education used to meet the minimum qualifications must be clearly stated in the application. If using completion of quarter/semester units to meet minimum qualifications, it must be clearly stated in in the Educational section of the application. Missing documentation may result in education/experience not being counted. Options: I have at least two (2) years of clerical experience. | I have one (1) year of clerical experience AND one (1) year (30 semester/45 quarter units) of college level business, office technology, or related course work at an accredited institution. | I have less than one (1) year of clerical experience.
EXPERIENCE: Two years of clerical experience.
EDUCATION: One year of college level business, office technology, or related course work at an accredited institution may be substituted for one year of the required experience.

Promotional : One year of experience in Los Rios Community College District performing clerical duties. (Promotional applies to regular, current Classified employees working with the Los Rios Community College District.) Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment. ( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.) Education must be from an accredited institution.
